recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12902 unless a future final tracker explicitly revisits CapabilityStatement conformance declaration semantics or the broader canonical|uri datatype pattern.
issue_request: FHIR-12902 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Conformance issue raised against DSTU2. It asked why CapabilityStatement.instantiates was typed uri rather than Reference and finalized a broader decision to define canonical and url primitive types, use canonical references for conformance/knowledge artifacts identified by canonical URL, update contained-reference and _include handling, and change CapabilityStatement.instantiates plus other conformance references to canonical.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn revision 13214, now git commit 2319e45e4115705f873661fe217ae2971eebc13f, which changed the historical CapabilityStatement spreadsheet row for CapabilityStatement.instantiates from uri to canonical(CapabilityStatement), introduced url and canonical primitives, and updated canonical-reference narrative. The current StructureDefinition XML source was later introduced by c69d71aa213de86d55e0261339c15e4bacd509e6 with CapabilityStatement.instantiates already canonical(CapabilityStatement).
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source also keeps related CapabilityStatement references such as implementationGuide, rest.resource.searchParam.definition, rest.resource.operation.definition, rest.compartment, rest.resource.profile, rest.resource.supportedProfile, messaging.supportedMessage.definition, and document.profile as canonical targets. Current datatype/reference narrative defines url and canonical, versioned canonical references, and the limits of Reference.reference for canonical URLs. Later FHIR-39173 considered a datatype for instantiatesCanonical/instantiatesUri pairs but was resolved Not Persuasive/No Change and does not reverse this canonical-reference decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current authoritative source already satisfies the seed request and the bounded wider CapabilityStatement portion of the resolution, so adding or rewriting source text would be redundant rather than corrective.

related_jiras.note: The same git-svn application commit added Reference.type while applying the FHIR-12902 canonical-reference changes; it was not independently decided here.
Later R5 ballot issue about instantiatesCanonical/instantiatesUri datatype patterns was resolved Not Persuasive/No Change and does not require changing CapabilityStatement.instantiates.
